senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) palace, the Temple; esp. the Holy, the hall containing the golden altar &c., contrad. to the Holy of Holies, v. דְּבִיר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 1:3">Ned. I, 3</cite> <he>כה׳</he> as forbidden as the offerings of the Temple (a vow formula). Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ <he>ומשחיתים לה׳</he> (not <he>ומשתחוים</he>, v. Rashi to <cite ref="Ezekiel 8:16">Ez. VIII, 16</cite>) and offended the Temple (through indecency); a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֵיכָלוֹת</he>.
